claim_boundary: All market history, earlier search output, and the themes used to construct Generation 5 have been seen. Any pass is a retrospective model-comparison result only. It cannot establish future profitability, independent alpha, options profitability, or permission for live capital.

static_qqq_equal_sectors_control.mechanism: Every 21 sessions rebalance to 50% QQQ and 50% divided equally across the original nine sector ETFs.

flex_top5_voladj_momentum_trend.mechanism: Rank all 19 non-BIL ETFs by 252-session total return divided by 252-session annualized volatility; assign five fixed 20% slots and place each failed inclusive-SMA210 slot in BIL.

source_pins.title: The trend is our friend: Risk parity, momentum and trend following in global asset allocation
source_pins.authors: Andrew Clare, James Seaton, Peter N. Smith, Stephen Thomas

source_pins.title: Price and Momentum as Robust Tactical Approaches to Global Equity Investing
source_pins.authors: Owain ap Gwilym, Andrew Clare, James Seaton, Stephen Thomas

sector_12_1_top3_individual_trend.mechanism: Rank the original nine sectors by 12-minus-1 momentum; assign three fixed one-third slots and place each failed inclusive-SMA210 slot in BIL.

source_pins.title: Price and Momentum as Robust Tactical Approaches to Global Equity Investing
source_pins.authors: Owain ap Gwilym, Andrew Clare, James Seaton, Stephen Thomas

qqq_vs_two_factor_residual_sector_basket.mechanism: Estimate each sector's older-window SPY/BIL market and QQQ-minus-SPY growth betas, rank recent fixed-beta residual information ratios, and hold the top-three sector basket only when its 12-minus-1 BIL-excess momentum exceeds QQQ; otherwise QQQ.

source_pins.title: Residual Momentum
source_pins.authors: David Blitz, Joop Huij, Martin Martens

long_only_tsmom_ewma60.mechanism: Among nine cross-asset ETFs with positive 252-session return over BIL, allocate inverse lagged EWMA volatility with delta=60/61, normalize risky gross to one, and put the residual in BIL.

source_pins.title: Time Series Momentum
source_pins.authors: Tobias J. Moskowitz, Yao Hua Ooi, Lasse Heje Pedersen

source_pins.title: Time series momentum and volatility scaling
source_pins.authors: Abby Y. Kim, Yiuman Tse, John K. Wald

raw_spy_track.objective: maximize the smaller development/validation SPY edge among raw-SPY qualifiers

growth_control_track.objective: maximize the smallest development/validation edge across QQQ and both static growth controls among growth-control qualifiers
